loss_policy: Pinned libcbh silently drops the listed proprietary annotation classes before the Accessible Chess bridge receives a record. Accessible Chess therefore cannot reconstruct, fabricate, or truthfully report per-record values for those classes. Their capability remains PARTIAL/unobservable until a backend exposes them with an independently verifiable oracle.
nag_fidelity_policy: For SymbolComment.evaluation only, the optional bridge reverses deterministic pinned-libcbh color-relative remapping back to the raw CBH evaluation byte that the independent ChessBase-export PGN uses as the NAG. Symbol and prefix fields are not normalized by this rule.
